title: lespedeza formosa var. albiflora
intro: Lespedeza formosa var. albiflora, commonly known as White Lespedeza, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the legume family and is native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, fever, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of White Lespedeza include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
